钱包默认支持 4337/7702/交易去关联
summary: terencechain 宣布 glamsterdam-devnet-7 上线，执行层把 EIP-2780 和 8037 的状态相关费用从固有 gas 移到运行时，共识层加入 EIP-7688 progressive containers。EthSystems 发布，为机构以太坊构建机密系统，锚定资金方包括 Bitmine、Sharplink 和 Joe Lubin。ethrex v21 初步支持 Hegotá 分叉和 EIP-8141 frame 交易。Ben Edgington 发布最终性用户调研第二篇。kassandraETH 呼吁钱包立即把 4337 UserOps、7702 委托和去关联交易作为默认。

items.title: terencechain：glamsterdam-devnet-7 上线
items.note: 23:39。共识层：EIP-7688 progressive containers，更新 payload 截止时间和 builder 生命周期参数；执行层：EIP-2780 和 8037 把状态相关费用从固有 gas 移出。
items.note_en: 23:39. Consensus layer: EIP-7688 progressive containers, plus updated payload deadlines and builder lifecycle parameters; execution layer: EIP-2780 and 8037 move state-dependent charges out of intrinsic gas.

items.title: EIP-8038：去掉对 EIP-8037 的循环依赖，复用规范 gas 符号
items.note: （jochem-brouwer）提交。2780、8037、8038 是 Glamsterdam EIP 中唯一的依赖环，PR 让 8038 成为独立的常规 gas 重定价，不改变任何收费值、条件、时机或退款行为。
items.title_en: EIP-8038: remove the circular EIP-8037 dependency and reuse canonical gas symbols
items.note_en: (jochem-brouwer), submitted. 2780, 8037 and 8038 form the only dependency cycle among Glamsterdam EIPs; the PR makes 8038 a standalone regular gas repricing, without changing any charge value, condition, timing or refund behavior.

items.title: EIP-8130：创建和导入时允许初始 actor 设置 expiry
items.note: （chunter-cb）提交。此前时间限制只能在部署后通过配置变更设置；现在每个初始 actor 可带 `uint48 expiry`（0 表示不过期），并计入地址承诺，钱包可以在创建账户时原子地发放有时限的密钥。
items.title_en: EIP-8130: allow initial actors to set an expiry at create and import
items.note_en: (chunter-cb), submitted. Previously time limits could only be set by a config change after deployment; now each initial actor can carry a `uint48 expiry` (0 means no expiry), committed in the address, so wallets can issue time-limited keys atomically when the account is created.

items.title: ethrex v21.0.0
items.note: 23:08，基于内存池的状态预热让主网区块执行快约 15%，并初步支持 Hegotá 分叉与 EIP-8141 frame 交易。
items.note_en: 23:08: mempool-based state prewarming makes mainnet block execution about 15% faster, and it ships initial Hegotá fork support with EIP-8141 frame transactions.

items.title: kassandraETH：4337 UserOps、7702 委托、去关联的交易活动都应是一等公民
items.note: 15:23，这应当现在就成为以太坊钱包的标准和默认。
items.title_en: kassandraETH: 4337 UserOps, 7702 delegations and unlinked transaction activity should all be first-class citizens
items.note_en: 15:23, and this should be the standard and default for Ethereum wallets now.

items.title: Magicians：时间锁账户恢复
items.note: 18:06（iyari），面向 ERC-4337/7579 智能账户，不依赖守护人：发起恢复需质押 `LockValue` ETH 并等待 `LockTime` 挑战窗口，期间所有者可以挑战。
items.note_en: 18:06 (iyari), for ERC-4337/7579 smart accounts without guardians: starting a recovery requires staking `LockValue` ETH and waiting out a `LockTime` challenge window, during which the owner can challenge.

keywords_en: EIP-2780 and 8037 move state-dependent charges out of intrinsic gas
summary_en: terencechain announced that glamsterdam-devnet-7 is live: on the execution layer, EIP-2780 and 8037 move state-dependent charges from intrinsic gas to runtime, and the consensus layer adds EIP-7688 progressive containers. EthSystems launched to build confidential systems for institutional Ethereum, with anchor funders including Bitmine, Sharplink and Joe Lubin. ethrex v21 ships initial support for the Hegotá fork and EIP-8141 frame transactions. Ben Edgington published the second post of his finality user research. kassandraETH called for wallets to make 4337 UserOps, 7702 delegations and unlinked transactions the default now.
